params.arms.order: interleaved per question; arm order alternates between questions
params.judge: pointwise correctness vs the reference answer, both orders (reference first, candidate first), JSON verdict {correct}, question/reference/candidate fenced as untrusted; run after all answers, the answer server stopped first
params.judge.model: qwen3-8b-q4km (Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.model: qwen3-4b-q4km (Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf, local llama-server llama-server-linux-x86_64-cpu (b11940), thinking off)
params.path: product: Retriever::pack_context_with (exclude_sensitive false) -> nuggetd::ask::ask_request_packed (no history) -> provider stream -> nuggetd::ask::AnswerFilter::packed (push/finish) -> AnswerFilter::check

sampling.seed: not sent: ChatRequest has no seed field, so the provider samples with its own seed (fixed temperature instead)

params.scoring: rule-based: answerable correct = every must group present and no abstention (must_not reported as stale_value_rate, not in correctness); unanswerable correct = abstention with no cited fact; see bench/src/suites/ask/score.rs
